title: Normalize a customer
description: Trim a customer name and normalize an email while preserving unknown contact data.
program: ASSERT(name != "", "Customer name must not be blank")

exercise.instruction: Change email to "  ADA+NEWS@EXAMPLE.COM  ", then run again.

edgeCases.name: Blank required name is rejected
edgeCases.expectedError: Customer name must not be blank

recipe.problem: Convert a customer record into a consistent API payload without inventing an email address or city.
prerequisites: Use JSON input. id is a required customer identifier; name is required text.
email is optional text or null; address is an optional object or null with an optional city.
explanation: ASSERT rejects absent required fields and a name that becomes blank after trimming.
name removes outer whitespace. email removes outer whitespace and lowercases text; blank or absent email becomes null.
The output explicitly maps id to customer_id and keeps an unknown city as null.
address uses an empty object before reading city: a missing leaf returns null, but reading through a null parent would fail.
limits: This performs text normalization, not email validation or identity verification.
The entire email is lowercased by this recipe policy. Keep the original address if your mail system requires case preservation.
Unknown optional fields stay null; other input fields are omitted.
